stories.title: The Whispering Woods
stories.author: A.J. Quinn
stories.story: The trees didn't just sway; they told secrets. Elara had always heard them, but today, they were yelling...
stories.moral: Listen closely to the warnings of nature.

stories.title: The Last Byte
stories.author: TechTales
stories.story: In a world run by code, Kaelen found the last analog book. It smelled of vanilla and dust...
stories.moral: Preserve the old while embracing the new.
